scope: Android tester release evidence for ReversR Rebuild versionCode 50 with corrected Android adaptive launcher icon.

Extracted base/res/mipmap-xxxhdpi-v4/ic_launcher.webp and ic_launcher_foreground.webp from the AAB.

Measured embedded adaptive foreground content at approximately 45.1% canvas width and 42.6% canvas height, reduced from build 49's approximately 51.4% width and 48.6% height.

validation: npx expo config --json verified android.adaptiveIcon.foregroundImage=./assets/android-adaptive-icon.png and backgroundColor=#ffffff
